newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.
Vessels: Europegasus loading 25,000 tonnes using big bags. Waiting to dock, nine vessels to load using big bags, one to load bulk.
Road: 73 trucks arrived carrying sugar on May 27. Total for May so far 2,644 trucks.
Vessels: Araya loading 35,200 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, four vessels to each load 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar (Unisea, Daiana P, Fulvia and Qing Jiang).
Stocks: Around 26,000 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable.
